Iron Chemistry and Physiology
Body Content, Forms, and Function
Iron, the 26th element of the periodic table, has an atomic weight of 55.85. Two common aqueous oxidation states, ferrous (Fe2+)
and ferric (Fe3+), enable iron to participate in oxidation/reduction reactions that are essential to energy metabolism by accepting or
